name: Anastasia Mischenko
bio: Anastasia Mischenko is a Belarusian-born French film director and writer. She studied Chinese and Italian languages and literature before earning an MBA. After working in business, she transitioned to filmmaking. For the past several years, Anastasia has been working closely with Andrey Zvyagintsev as his assistant.

credits.title: MOIRA
credits.overview: After missing her train, a woman returns home to find a presence which shouldn’t be there — and crosses an irreversible line.

credits.title: Minotaur
credits.overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

credits.title: Candy Wrap
credits.overview: Dasha confessed to her mother, that she has been desperately trying to overcome romantic feelings for her best friend's fiancé. Little does she know her always-right-Mum is in a peculiar situation herself…
